mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace (id, resource_pool_id, name, description, namespace, service_account_name, volcano_queue_name, primary_cluster_id, max_pods, node_count, created_by, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{resourcePoolId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{namespace}, #{serviceAccountName}, #{volcanoQueueName}, #{primaryClusterId}, #{maxPods}, #{nodeCount}, #{createdBy}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workspace ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM workspace WHERE resource_pool_id = #{resourcePoolId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
